notes:
Summary: ContactWorks is Cobalt Verity's contact center platform for merchant and clinic payment flows. Heavy compliance needs: PCI + PHI. Looking for VPC/private deployment w/ customer-managed KMS, audit trail retention (7+ years for some merchants), SSO via SAML, and ability to redact or never-log full card data and PHI. Primary interest: agent assist (real time suggestions), automated ticket summarization, tool-calling to create/update payment disputes in Zendesk, and reranking to surface high-risk transactions to agents.

Key quotes & signal: "We need deterministic behavior during holiday spikes — no surprise model fallbacks that slow down auth flows." — Head of Support.
"If we can't show full audit trails and encrypted KV control, security won't sign off." — Security reviewer.

Environment preferences: VPC with private control plane, option for on-premise air-gapped staging, strict egress rules. Must integrate with existing SSO (Okta) and on-prem HSM for key wrapping. Want per-route latency SLOs: 95th < 350ms for agent suggestions, <600ms for tool-calls that reach external systems. Throughput: 1.2k concurrent agent sessions during peak, burst to 4k for seasonal surge. Cost sensitivity but will pay for guaranteed latency and isolation.

POC ask: 2-week spike test using realistic replay of last year's Black Friday traffic (sample anonymized), demo of ticket summarization for PHI redaction, and proof of tool-calling reliability (10k concurrent webhook operations across multiple regions). Must include detailed cost estimate for dedicated GPU pools + predicted unit cost with caching.

Security path: completed initial security questionnaire (attached), waiting on dev/test environment architecture diagram from Redwood; scheduled pen test kickoff after architecture sign-off; vendor risk team requires copy of SOC2 + HIPAA BAAs.

Sales notes (AE): deal influenced by integration quality with Zendesk + ability to keep sensitive tokens out of logs. Close criteria: security sign-off + successful spike day under agreed latency.
